current_affairs.summary: The United Nations approved its first-ever comprehensive treaty on cybercrime, aiming to strengthen international cooperation to combat cyber threats, illicit data transfers, and online child exploitation.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper II (International Treaties) & GS Paper III (Cybersecurity)

current_affairs.topic: Sub-categorization within Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST)
current_affairs.summary: The Supreme Court held that states have the constitutional authority to create sub-classifications within SC/ST categories to provide targeted affirmative action to the most backward sub-groups.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper II (Indian Constitution, Reservation & Social Justice)

current_affairs.topic: Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) for India's Energy Transition
current_affairs.summary: NITI Aayog recommended increased private sector participation and policy updates to accelerate the deployment of Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) to meet India's net-zero targets.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III (Nuclear Energy, Technology & Environment)

current_affairs.topic: RBI Guidelines on Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Lending Platforms
current_affairs.summary: The Reserve Bank of India issued stricter compliance norms for Non-Banking Financial Company - Peer-to-Peer (NBFC-P2P) platforms to prevent unfair credit-enhancement practices and protect retail investors.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III (Indian Economy & Financial Regulation)

current_affairs.topic: Great Nicobar Island Development Project and Ecological Concerns
current_affairs.summary: Concerns were re-highlighted regarding the environmental impact on the Shompen and Nicobarese tribes and the endemic biodiversity due to the mega transshipment port and infrastructure expansion in Great Nicobar.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III (Ecology, Biodiversity & Tribal Rights)
